about: The cage for worker-written code under hand-ins made at once. The same correct file is handed in each time, each in a process of its own. No agent and no model ran. Measured on the machine this file was written on.

before_the_change.what: every cage was one shared user, and ending that user's leftovers after a run ended the other cages
before_the_change.seen_in_the_run: stage q200: the queue counted 176 hand-ins that passed their examples; the withheld tests verified 197 of 200
